name: daily-report

parameters.query: SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE is_active = 1

SELECT SUM(duration_sec) AS toplam, SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle=0 THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) AS aktif, SUM(CASE WHEN is_idle=1 THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END) AS bosta FROM activity_logs WHERE user_id = {{$json.id}} AND CAST(logged_at AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)

SELECT TOP 5 app_name, SUM(duration_sec) AS sn FROM activity_logs WHERE user_id = {{$json.id}} AND CAST(logged_at AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND is_idle = 0 AND app_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY app_name ORDER BY sn DESC

_comment: Kurulum: 1) Telegram Bot Token'ı n8n Credentials'a ekle. 2) Her kullanıcı için chat_id'yi users tablosuna ekle (telegram_chat_id kolonu). 3) SQL sorgularını güncelleyin.
